text:
marco: Dropping a small sketch + link: https://figma.com/file/NEW_COMPACT_SKETCH. Want feedback on a slightly different pattern: a left-aligned role legend, compact rows, and a single inline "Details" control instead of many chips. Also SSO copy and audit nav persistence. anya: I like the legend idea 6; it helps scanning. But the Details control must be one tabbable target per row. Don't make each permission a separate tabbable chip. Use `button aria-expanded` + a concise SR readout. sasha: Agree. For SSO copy, avoid words like "Enforce". Suggest: "Require SSO for org sign-in" and an inline helper: "Active sessions remain; new sign-ins use your IdP." Put that helper in aria-describedby so SRs read it. eva: Small accessibility catch: the compact rows removed the visible focus ring in the mocks. Please ensure a 2px high-contrast focus outline. Also check color contrast for role legend icons. raul: Audit log behavior: we should persist filters (date range + actor + event type) when you navigate away from Audit to Roles and back. URL params is best so back/forward works and people can share links during incident review. Avoid putting emails in the URL; use opaque IDs. marco: For mobile, hover previews won't work. The Details button should expand an inline summary on tap. Keep it simple: 1-2 lines max. anya: ARIA snippet for the Details button I added in figma notes: ```
View tickets, escalate incidents
``` anya: Also recommend announcing effective permissions briefly when the row receives focus: "Support Agent. Permissions: view tickets, escalate." Use polite aria-live. sasha: Invite CTA microcopy: change from "Send invite" to dynamic "Invite users" -> "Invite 4 users and assign roles" when counts known. Less surprising. eva: Focus trap bug: open invite drawer -> open Details -> Shift+Tab sometimes escapes the drawer header. QA found it. Need to trap focus to the topmost overlay and ensure Esc closes panels in reverse order. QA ticket QA-9567. raul: Engineering note: persisting filters via URL params is doable; we'll keep a short set of params. I'll scope effort once design gives the preserved-state UI. marco: Action items: - change SSO label to "Require SSO for org sign-in" + helper text in aria-describedby (sasha) - single tabbable Details button per row with aria-expanded + polite aria-live summary (anya) - restore visible focus outline and check contrast (eva) - dynamic invite CTA that reflects counts/roles (sasha) - trap focus in invite drawer and Esc behavior for nested panels (eng ticket, QA-9567) - persist audit filters via URL params (raul) marco: Can design update the compact screen with the legend + Details button + SSO helper copy by EOD? Eng needs it to estimate QA-9567. design-bot: Created ticket PROD-6011: "Compact roles: left legend, Details control, SSO helper, audit state" assigned to design + eng-ux. qa-bot: Logged QA-9567 for the invite drawer focus trap and filter persistence. Repro steps attached. anya: I'll add the SR announcement copy to the figma notes. sasha: I'll update the component copy for SSO and the invite CTA variant. marco: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: let's keep the Details content non-interactive by default so it's lighter for SRs, and surface actions (edit/clone) behind a three-dot menu if needed.
